notes:
This dataset includes information about applications submitted to the Committee of Adjustment for minor variances to zoning by-laws, and consents.

Toronto City Council has appointed a Committee of Adjustment consisting of citizen members. The Committee of Adjustment operates as four panels: [Etobicoke York](https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/committee-of-adjustment/etobicoke-york-schedule/), 
[North York](https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/committee-of-adjustment/north-york-schedule/), [Toronto & East York](https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/committee-of-adjustment/toronto-east-york-schedule/) and [Scarborough](https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/committee-of-adjustment/scarborough-schedule/). They regularly hold public hearings to consider applications for minor variances and consents.

For final decision details contact the local [Committee of Adjustment](https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/committee-of-adjustment/).

For more information, visit the [Application Information Centre](http://app.toronto.ca/DevelopmentApplications/mapSearchSetup.do?action=init).
